title: Contracts Specialist
description:
Aypa Power, a Blackstone portfolio company, is a leading developer, owner, and operator of utility-scale energy storage and hybrid renewable projects that power our communities and cities. Our mission is to responsibly decarbonize the grid and make North American energy markets more affordable, sustainable, and efficient. Aypa is well-capitalized and uniquely positioned to lean forward on projects with well-suited deal structures to meet our customers’ needs. We have been at the forefront of energy storage development since our first energy storage project came online in 2018. As a leader in our industry, we have over 22 GW of utility-scale energy storage and hybrid renewable energy projects in development and 33 projects in operation or construction across North America.

We are seeking a highly driven, detail-oriented Contracts Specialist to join our legal and commercial teams in Austin, Texas. This role sits at the intersection of contract administration and document control, supporting the full lifecycle of Aypa's supply, service, and EPC contracts — from drafting and negotiation support through execution, tracking, and recordkeeping. The ideal candidate is a seasoned contracts professional and an extremely organized self-starter with expert-level command of Microsoft Word redlining and document-comparison tools, Adobe Acrobat, and e-signature platforms. The candidate is capable of turning counterparty markups into clean, execution-ready documents at high volume and documents with precision and staying focused under pressure in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary gatekeeper for all contract documents, maintaining rigorous document and version control across all forms, contracts, and exhibits;
  • Own the intake and turn-by-turn processing of documents received from counterparties; confirming that a received markup matches its transmittal, reconstructing tracked changes where a counterparty returns an untracked or flattened draft, scrubbing metadata before anything goes back out, and maintaining a clear audit trail of every version;
  • Support incorporation of Aypa standard terms and exhibits into battery and solar PV supply, service, and EPC contracts, ensuring adherence to contract templates and documentation principles;
  • Prepare initial drafts of, and perform initial review on contracting documents at each turn, driving documents toward execution within expected timelines;
  • Work with internal stakeholders and external counsel on supply and EPC contracts, progressing exhibits and deal terms to completion;
  • Collaborate with legal, finance, engineering, procurement, and commercial teams (including the Contracts, Procurement, and Pre-Construction managers) to structure optimal contract scoping and incorporate negotiated terms into agreements, ensuring alignment with project requirements and objectives;
  • Maintain contracting dashboards and trackers to monitor deal progression;
  • Assemble execution packages, compiling exhibit sets, preparing signature blocks and issuing fully executed conformed copies to the deal team and the records repository;
  • Deploy corporate contracting tools, templates, processes, systems, and guidelines;
  • Other duties as assigned or required.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree, or a degree in contract management, construction/project management, or a related field or relevant experience;
  • Two to five years of experience in contract administration, contract management, paralegal, or transactional support roles; hands-on experience with EPC or equipment supply contracting in energy storage, renewables, or utility-scale infrastructure strongly preferred;
  • Demonstrated expert-level command of Microsoft Word for contract work: Track Changes and comment workflows, Compare and Combine, styles, multilevel clause numbering and cross-references. Proficient in the use of Excel, Outlook, Adobe Acrobat, and Adobe Sign, and the ability to manage complex, high-volume document workflows. Candidates should expect a practical redlining and document-cleanup exercise as part of the interview process;
  • Working familiarity with the substance and structure of EPC and equipment supply agreements in the energy sector, scope of work and exhibit sets, milestone payment and delivery schedules, limited notice to proceed and notice to proceed, change orders, liquidated damages, performance guarantees and warranties, bonding and parent guarantees, and interconnection and permitting deliverables — sufficient to recognize when a counterparty turn changes something material;
  • Extreme attention to detail with a rigorous, disciplined approach to document and version control;
  • Highly driven self-starter who can work independently, remain focused and on task, and manage numerous competing priorities in a high-volume, fast-paced environment;
  • Extremely organized, with excellent planning skills and the ability to plan, oversee, and personally execute multiple projects simultaneously;
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills;
  • Strong interpersonal and diplomatic skills, with the ability to interact effectively with people at all levels of the organization;
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted contract review and drafting tools, with a clear-eyed understanding of their limitations and the discipline to verify every output against the source document;
  • Highest standards of ethics and integrity;
  • Ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and adjust to changing priorities under pressure.

Compensation and Location

Salary: A base salary commensurate with experience.
Bonus: An annual bonus will be awarded based on both individual performance and the overall success of the business.
Benefits: Aypa offers an attractive benefits package with excellent health care/dental/vision, 401k matching, unlimited vacation, paid parental leave, and other health/wellness benefits.
Location: Remote (USA). The ability to work in the United States is a requirement.
Travel: Candidate must be willing to travel 10–15% for direct vendor negotiation and industry trade shows.

We hire passionate, dedicated, and forward-thinking individuals from different backgrounds and value unique perspectives and experiences. With a focus on belonging, we are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all.

title: Manager, FP&A
description:
Aypa Power, a Blackstone portfolio company, is a leading developer, owner, and operator of utility-scale energy storage and hybrid renewable projects that power our communities and cities. Our mission is to responsibly decarbonize the grid and make North American energy markets more affordable, sustainable, and efficient. Aypa Power is seeking a FP&A Manager to join our growing Finance team and play a key role in financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and decision support across our renewable energy platform.

This role will partner closely with Development, Construction, Operations, Commercial, Project Finance, Accounting, and other functional leaders to translate business activity into financial forecasts, analyze performance, identify risks and opportunities, and provide actionable insights to senior leadership.

The Manager will have meaningful ownership of Aypa’s recurring forecasting, budgeting, management reporting, and financial analysis processes across both corporate functions and our portfolio of development, construction, and operating assets. The position will also play an important role in continuing to improve and scale Aypa’s FP&A capabilities through automation, process improvement, and effective use of Workday Adaptive Planning.

The ideal candidate is a strong FP&A professional who combines financial modeling and analytical capabilities with business judgment, curiosity, and the ability to communicate complex financial information clearly. This individual should be comfortable operating in a fast-paced, capital-intensive environment and partnering across the organization to improve both financial performance and the processes used to manage the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own key components of the company’s annual budget, recurring forecasts, and long-range planning processes across corporate functions and Aypa’s renewable energy portfolio;
  • Develop and maintain project- and portfolio-level forecasts across Development, Construction, and Operating Assets, including revenue, DevEx, CapEx, OpEx, cash flows, and corporate SG&A;
  • Partner with Development, Construction, Operations, Commercial, Project Finance, and other business leaders to understand performance, challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and improve forecast accuracy;
  • Analyze actual results versus budget and forecast, develop clear variance explanations, and provide actionable insights to management;
  • Support monthly and quarterly management reporting, including financial results, KPIs, project performance, cash flow, and forward-looking outlooks for senior leadership and other key stakeholders;
  • Support company and project-level cash forecasting, liquidity planning, scenario analysis, and capital requirements;
  • Evaluate financial performance throughout the project lifecycle and translate changes in development, construction, and operations into financial impacts;
  • Drive improvements to FP&A processes by simplifying, standardizing, and automating forecasting, reporting, and analytical workflows;
  • Leverage Workday Adaptive Planning and other finance tools to enhance financial models, reporting, dashboards, analytics, and business visibility;
  • Partner with Accounting, IT, and other teams to improve financial data flows, reporting processes, data quality, and system integrations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field;
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, financial planning, or a related role;
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, variance analysis, cash flow, and management reporting;
  • Demonstrated experience owning or materially supporting recurring budgeting and forecasting processes;
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel;
  • Strong business partnership and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex financial and operational data into actionable insights;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, growing organization;
  • Experience with enterprise planning, reporting, or financial systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in renewable energy, power, infrastructure, private equity-backed businesses, or another capital-intensive industry;
  • Experience supporting project-based businesses and financial planning across development, construction, and operating stages;
  • Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or another enterprise planning platforms;
  • Familiarity with project finance, investment analysis, infrastructure asset economics, or project-level cash flow modeling;
  • Experience improving or automating FP&A reporting, dashboards, and planning processes;
  • CPA, CFA, MBA, or other relevant professional qualification is a plus.

Compensation and Location

Salary: A base salary commensurate with experience;
Bonus: An annual bonus will be awarded based on individual performance and the overall success of the business;
Benefits: Aypa offers an attractive benefits package with excellent health care/dental/vision, 401k matching, unlimited vacation, paid parental leave, and other health/wellness benefits;
Location: Hybrid (USA). Ability to work in the United States is a requirement. Preference is given to candidates located in Austin, TX, or willing to relocate.
